purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: tech interview; vocabulary (返信/音声/ツール/教材/ダウン) in natural home.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 学習ツールを、開発したんですね。
lines.style: engaged young interviewer voice, soft warm curious focus throughout

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい、音声で学べる教材ツールです。
lines.en: Yes, a material tool you learn from by voice.
lines.style: measured engineer voice, soft warm informative clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 音声は、聞き取りやすいですか?
lines.en: Is the audio easy to hear?
lines.style: curious young interviewer voice, soft warm focus throughout

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: クリアな音声に、こだわりました。
lines.style: clear engineer voice, soft warm informative clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: サーバーが、ダウンすることは?
lines.en: Does the server ever go down?
lines.style: engaged young interviewer voice, soft warm focus throughout

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: ダウンしないよう、対策しています。
lines.en: We take measures so it doesn't go down.
lines.style: measured engineer voice, soft warm informative clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 質問への返信も、早いんですか?
lines.en: Are replies to questions fast too?
lines.style: curious young interviewer voice, soft warm focus throughout

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 返信を、自動で早く返す教材です。
lines.en: It's a material tool that auto-replies fast.
lines.style: warm engineer voice, soft warm informative closing clarity throughout
